item.title: The Greater Arlington Chamber of Commerce in partnership with the Arlington ISD and is pr…
item.description:
The Greater Arlington Chamber of Commerce in partnership with the Arlington ISD and is proud to offer the What’s Your Big Idea? Entrepreneurship Contest.
The What’s Your Big Idea? Entrepreneurship Contest is a contest created by kids for kids. Twenty-one years later, the WYBIEC is still fostering the entrepreneurial spirit in 3rd-12th graders.
Any students interested in entering the contest should stop by Mrs. Grenier’s room 906 to pick up an entry form. All entries must be submitted by Wednesday, November 4.
Full contest details can be found at, https://www.arlingtontx.com/bigidea/ www.arlingtontx.com/bigidea/
